title: What's happening, today and this week

criteria.text: A row returns the posts whose start time falls inside its window, soonest first
criteria.note: `happeningRows` makes one `browse_feed` call per row with the window and `sort: 'soonest'`, posts only (`load.ts`); rows show under Updates since #800 [V]. Reviewed no: #266 has no `Reviewed by:`, #815 `review-skipped`. Shipped: green on 2a0d7f7c and b7766901. Smoked unknown: last green run is before #815. Checked: loader test is `[guards F091.1 partial]` (arguments only); SQL tests in `tests/migrations-browse-feed.test.ts` unmarked (#612).

criteria.text: A row returns only posts that start inside its window
criteria.note: #815 (change #814, build A of the pitch audit, 2026-10-16, no scenario change) made the window hold a post that is on during it, so a post that started earlier and has not ended appears in 'today' (`coalesce(ends_at, starts_at) >= p_starts_from`; test 'a time window holds a post that is on during it') [V]. That contradicts 'only posts whose start time falls inside'; the scenario has no ruling for it. Routed to `scope-scenario` (amend to 'on during the window'); nothing filed.

criteria.note: `happeningWindows`: every row starts now, today ends at metro midnight, week and weekend end Monday 00:00, daylight saving handled [V]. The zone is the constant `America/Los_Angeles` until #173 (open) gives each metro its own. Checked: `[guards F091.2]` in `src/lib/metro/happening.test.ts`. Reviewed no (#266 no line).
